title: 第10章 一只手镇压你

content_zh:
“石波，你认输吧，你打不过我的。”萧腾背负双手，用一种俯视的目光，看着石波。
半步后天，是炼体境到后天境的一个过渡境界，萧腾体内虽然还没有衍生真气，但是却有一颗真气种子，可以提供远超炼体境的力量。
他，已经可以傲视全镇的同辈，今天他就是最耀眼的天才，荣耀属于他，美人也属于他。
“认输？”如同野人般长发散乱的石波摇头，沉声道，“不战就认输，那不是我石波的行事风格！”
“我想试试，我和你之间，有多大的差距！”石波身上涌现冲天战意，身形暴起，一套掌法在其手中行如流水施展而开。
“开碑掌！”
随着石波双掌拍出，一道道掌风密不透风的向着萧腾笼罩而去，每一道掌风都有开碑裂石的威力。
“哼，我念你资质不错，本想让你有颜面的下台，既然你冥顽不灵，那就别怪我了。”萧腾冷哼，迈步走在掌风中，如同闲庭渡步，双掌猛然朝前一推。
狂猛的气爆声响起，摧枯拉朽将石波的掌风尽皆击溃，余势未停的轰在石波身上。
石波一口鲜血喷出，身体离地而起，砸在擂台下，半天爬不起来。
“萧腾！”石家村村长石战猛然站起，手中的酒杯被捏个粉碎，“选婚比武，禁止伤人，难道这个规矩你不知道吗！”
石波可是石家村的第一天才，要是有个三长两短，那石家村的损失就大了。
“萧腾你太过分了！”擂台下石家村的村民愤怒大喝，群情激奋，就差冲上去了。
萧天雄和吴狮对视一眼，神情沉重，萧腾做的的确太过分了，选婚大会本来是喜事，现在却见血了。
要是历年的选婚比武都这样，三个村子早就打起了。
在村民的检查下，所幸石波伤势不是太严重，休养一段时间就好了。在一位村民的搀扶下，石波面色苍白的坐回了虎座。
擂台上，萧腾没有一点羞愧，反而暗中冷笑起来：“哼，我萧腾可是十五岁的半步后天，别说打伤石波了，就算我把他杀了，村长也会力保我的。”
萧腾有着这份自信。
“诸位，我儿的确下手重了点，选婚大会后，我会亲自上门赔罪。”萧霸笑着走了出来，安抚石家村村民激动的情绪。
看到石波没有大碍，再加上萧霸的态度，不满的声音渐渐低了下去。

萧霸站起身，笑着看向萧大山：“大山，接下来应该不用比了吧？诸位亲眼所见，我儿已经达到半步后天，不是什么废人的种，都有资格和我儿比试的。”
萧霸说着，还冷冷的扫了萧阳一眼。
萧阳的面色立刻变了，身躯愤怒的颤抖着。
他经脉俱碎，成为废人的事情全镇皆知，但是生性纯朴的村民，都尽量避免触及萧阳心底的伤疤。
但萧霸，却当着全镇子人的面，说他是废人。
“萧霸！”萧叶迈步走了过来，“你儿子靠着蛟蛇血突破到半步后天，难道很值得炫耀吗？”
萧霸冷冷道：“比你强就行，你还是跟着你那废人的爹，滚回家吧！”
“是吗？那你看清楚了。”在众目睽睽之下，萧叶登临擂台，双目激射锋锐的精芒。
“我萧叶，不需要蛟蛇血，也可以横扫所有人！”这一刻，萧叶如同一把出鞘的长剑，剑指苍穹。
“不要！”萧阳看到这一幕，大惊失色。
“输定了……”虎座上的石波摇头道，他和萧叶同处于炼体九重巅峰，他败了，萧叶肯定也好不到哪里去。
“呵呵……不自量力。”少女队伍中的吴媚儿冷笑。
擂台之上，萧腾背负双手，讥讽道：“萧叶，我还以为你要当缩头乌龟呢，没想到你居然有胆子上来。”
“我讨厌你很久了，今天我将亲手终止这种讨厌，萧家村第一天才，永远是我！”说完，萧腾大吼，黑发无风自动，体内真气种子一颤，流转出充沛的力量。
“尝一尝，什么叫绝望吧！”萧腾神情狰狞，走向萧腾，每一步落下，擂台便摇晃数下，留下深深的脚印，声响震天。
“爹，看着你儿子，是如何的优秀吧。”萧叶望着萧腾，轻声自语。
萧腾浑身气势攀升至巅峰，他动了，速度远超炼体境，如同山洪爆发的力量倾泻而出，欲将萧叶淹没。
“住手！”萧天雄惊怒，但却来不及阻止，因为这一切发生的太快，已经演变成萧家村最出色的两个小辈厮杀了。

content_en:
"Shi Bo, give up, you can't beat me." Xiao Teng put his hands behind his back and looked at Shi Bo with a downward gaze.
Half-Step Acquired Heaven is a transitional state from the Body Refining Realm to the Acquired Heaven Realm. Although Xiao Teng has not yet derived the True Qi in his body, there is a True Qi Seed that can provide power far beyond the Body Refining Realm.
He can already look down upon his peers in the town. Today he is the most dazzling genius. The glory belongs to him, and so does the beauty.
"Admit defeat?" Shi Bo, who had long and disheveled hair like a savage, shook his head and said solemnly, "Admitting defeat without fighting is not my Shi Bo's style!"
"I want to try to see how big the gap is between you and me!" Shi Bo's body surged with fighting spirit, his body rose up, and a set of palm techniques spread out in his hands like flowing water.
"Open the monument palm!"
As Shi Bo struck out with his palms, a series of palm winds enveloped Xiao Teng in an airtight manner. Each palm wind had the power to crack monuments and rocks.
"Hmph, I think you have good qualifications, and I wanted you to step down with dignity. Since you are stubborn, don't blame me." Xiao Teng snorted coldly, walked in the wind of his palms, like walking in a leisurely way, and suddenly pushed forward with his palms.
A violent explosion of energy sounded, overwhelming Shi Bo's palm wind, and the remaining force continued to hit Shi Bo.
Shi Bo spurted out a mouthful of blood, his body rose from the ground, and fell under the ring. He couldn't get up for a long time.
"Xiao Teng!" Shi Zhan, the head of Shijia Village, stood up suddenly, and the wine glass in his hand was crushed to pieces. "It is forbidden to hurt others in the marriage competition. Don't you know this rule?"
Shi Bo is the number one genius in Shijiacun. If there are three shortcomings, then Shijiacun will suffer great losses.
"Xiao Teng, you've gone too far!" The villagers of Shijia Village shouted angrily under the ring. The crowd was so excited that they almost rushed forward.
Xiao Tianxiong and Wu Shi looked at each other with heavy expressions. Xiao Teng did indeed go too far. The marriage selection meeting was originally a happy event, but now it has seen blood.
If the previous marriage competitions had been like this, the three villages would have started fighting.
Under the inspection of the villagers, fortunately Shi Bo's injury was not too serious and he would be fine after a period of rest. With the help of a villager, Shi Bo sat back on the tiger seat with a pale face.
In the ring, Xiao Teng didn't feel any shame. Instead, he sneered secretly: "Humph, I, Xiao Teng, am only a fifteen-year-old. Let alone hurt Shi Bo, even if I kill him, the village chief will protect me."
Xiao Teng has this confidence.
"Everyone, my son did strike too hard. After the marriage selection meeting, I will personally come to apologize." Xiao Ba walked out with a smile to calm the excited emotions of the villagers in Shijia Village.
Seeing that Shi Bo was okay and Xiao Ba's attitude, his dissatisfied voice gradually became lowered.
Xiao Ba stood up and looked at Xiao Dashan with a smile: "Da Shan, there should be no need to compete next, right? You have seen with your own eyes that my son has already reached half the level of acquired skills. He is not a useless person and is qualified to compete with my son."
Xiao Ba said and glanced at Henry Zhang coldly.
Henry Zhang’s complexion changed immediately, and his body was shaking angrily.
The whole town knew that his meridians were broken and he became a cripple, but the simple-minded villagers tried their best to avoid touching the scars in Xiao Yang's heart.
But Xiao Ba called him a useless person in front of the whole town.
"Xiao Ba!" Xiao Ye walked over, "Your son relied on the blood of a dragon snake to break through half a step after tomorrow. Is it worth showing off?"
Xiao Ba said coldly: "As long as I am better than you, you should follow your useless father and go home!"
"Really? Then you can see clearly." In full view of everyone, Xiao Ye stepped onto the stage, his eyes blazing with sharp light.
"I, Xiao Ye, don't need the blood of a dragon snake to sweep away everyone!" At this moment, Xiao Ye was like an unsheathed long sword, pointing at the sky.
“No!” Henry Zhang was shocked when he saw this scene.
"We will definitely lose..." Shi Bo on the tiger seat shook his head. He and Xiao Ye were in the same place.He was defeated at the ninth level of body refining, and Xiao Ye was definitely not much better.
"Haha... You don't overestimate your capabilities." Wu Mei'er in the girls' team sneered.
On the ring, Xiao Teng put his hands behind his back and said sarcastically: "Xiao Ye, I thought you were going to be a coward, but I didn't expect you to have the courage to come up."
"I have hated you for a long time, and today I will put an end to this hatred with my own hands. The number one genius in Xiaojia Village will always be me!" After saying that, Xiao Teng roared, his black hair moved without wind, and the energy seeds in his body trembled, flowing out with abundant power.
"Have a taste of despair!" Xiao Teng walked towards Xiao Teng with a ferocious expression. Every time he took a step, the arena shook several times, leaving deep footprints and making a loud sound.
"Dad, look at how outstanding your son is." Xiao Ye looked at Xiao Teng and whispered to himself.
Xiao Teng's aura climbed to its peak. He moved at a speed far exceeding that of the Body Refining Realm. It was like the power of a mountain torrent pouring out, trying to drown Xiao Ye.
"Stop!" Xiao Tianxiong was shocked and angry, but he had no time to stop it, because it all happened too fast, and it had already turned into a fight between the two most outstanding juniors in Xiaojia Village.
